headline: Council to review donation acceptances, police grants, a $12,000 Wayfinding Signs payment, and an ordinance change to fee publication rules.
summary: The committee will consider accepting several donations and grants, including police-related funding, approve $12,000 for the Wayfinding Signs Project, and review a proposed change to the city's fee publication rule. The City Auditor will also report on accounts with expenditures exceeding authorization.
items: Accept $185 in donations for the Archives Committee
Accept $2,785 in donations for Cape Ann Veterans Services
Accept $10,050 in donations for Elder Services
Approve use of funds for the Recovery Coach Academy (Police Dept)
Accept FY27 State 911 Training Grant of $95,636.25
Accept FY27 Support and Incentive Grant of $102,983
Reimburse Police Department $9,922.24 (#2027-SBT-1) and $401.33 (#2027-SBT-2) for polling place details at the September 1, 2026 State Primary
Approve $12,000 (#2027-SA-3) to install a portion of the Wayfinding Signs Project
Consider CC#2026-018 (Gross) to amend Ch. 2, Art. 2, Sec. 28 'Fees' by deleting the newspaper publication requirement for fee changes
Review City Auditor's memorandum on accounts with expenditures exceeding authorization and the Auditor's Report
Note: Memorandum from the Principal Assessor on tax classification continued to October 22, 2026
location: 1st Floor Council Conference Room, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
